Question Choices: Write the expected-value formula for a discrete random variable X with finitely many possible values.
Hints: Multiply each value by its probability.|Then add across all outcomes.
Solution: For a finite distribution, E(X)=sum over all possible values x of x*P(X=x). Multiply each value by its own probability and add. This weighted average need not be a possible single result. For independent repetitions with the same distribution, sample averages tend toward E(X). E(X)=sum xP(x).
